formulas.break_even_conversion: (cost*Hfree +fixed/N) /[947.727 -cost*(Hpaid-Hfree)]; feasible only if denominator>0 and result<=1
formulas.margin_definition: (gross revenue -payment fee -variable cost)/gross revenue, before free-user cross-subsidy, fixed, CAC and income tax

critical_limits: 2/4/60 is a PILOT, capacity unmeasured; no quoted VM configuration is proven for any N/workload. Conditional fixed balances are illustrative financial floors only.
Daily1000 caseA =30000 input hours/month =1000 hours/day; no small-VM capacity claim.

35 RUB/h includes local Cloud.ru DeepSeek Pro +Whisper,10% model retry reserve and S3 first30days at1.1GB/input-hour. Flash30 is alternative with RF geography unproved.22.204 is raw Whisper-only price floor, omits LLM/render/storage/retry/fixed and is not a deployable all-in plan.
Actual Free900minutes/day exceeds Paid270minutes/day: dangerous demo inversion. Free30minutes/MONTH or one-time30minutes are proposals only; current Free forever promise is not changed.
Global20LLMcalls/day and2000minutes/day block scaling. One1h job/day/user at1000needs1000calls/day and60000minutes/day, excluding retries. Any increase needs approved budget caps.
Payments off in observed runtime; revenue is hypothetical.

30day storage baseline is not lifetime cost. Actual original retention lacks a fixedTTL and paid clips can persist indefinitely while subscriptions renew. One-time signup credit does not imply one-time lifetime storage cost.
Excluded: income tax,CAC,support,wages,backup compute,extra disk/egress,retention beyond30days,reasoning above2koutput and retries beyond10% reserve.
